title: Completion existence agrees along Q0 without equating the thresholds
statement: For fixed F,Q0=b^2+c^2 and ANY cubic C,the analytic theorem equates: F+C+nu Q0 is globally ROC for SOME finite nu; it is globally QC for SOME finite nu; and C lies in the explicit4-dimensional N. Here N={C in admitted V:kappa_C(E11)=kappa_C(E22)=0} with COMPLETED acoustic cost. Finite differentiation gives DC at both roots zero plus two jet constraints; the E22 null is U_(0,1)K2,not K2. Eighteen rational rows have rank16 on20cubics; N has zero intersection with the4-dimensional translation-cubic space. For C=sum t_j C_j,a sufficient nu=2^86(sum|t_j|)^2 is loose. ROC/QC thresholds at a given coefficient are NOT identified,and other quadratics or1859 are outside this classification.
